function.name: calculate_investment_value
function.description: Calculate the future value of an investment given the principal, interest rate and term. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

principal.description: The initial amount of the investment. This is a float type value.

interest_rate.description: The annual interest rate in percentage. Enter as a decimal (for 5%, enter 0.05). This is a float type value.

term.description: The term of the investment in years.

compounding.description: The number of times that interest is compounded per year. Default is 1 (annually).

message.content:
Sure! Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and international horror films you might enjoy:

| # | Title | Year | Director | Notes |
|---|-------|------|----------|-------|
| 1 | **《驚聲尖叫》** (Scream) | 1996 | Wes Craven | 现代恐怖片的代表，混合了自我意识与传统恐怖元素。 |
| 2 | **《午夜凶鈴》** (The Ring) | 2002 | Gore Verbinski | 经典日式恐怖改编，氛围阴森。 |
| 3 | **《陰兒房》** (The Others) | 2001 | Alejandro Amenábar | 以光影与心理恐怖为主，结局惊悚。 |
| 4 | **《鬼入侵》** (Paranormal Activity) | 2007 | Oren Peli | 低成本、极具现实感的“found footage”。 |
| 5 | **《驚魂》** (Hereditary) | 2018 | Ari Aster | 现代恐怖中的心理与超自然结合。 |
| 6 | **《咒怨》** (Ju-on) | 2000 | Takashi Miike | 日本恐怖片的代表，循环式恐怖。 |
| 7 | **《寂靜之地》** (A Quiet Place) | 2018 | John Krasinski | 通过声音与沉默制造紧张感。 |
| 8 | **《黑色星期五》** (The Grudge) | 2004 | Takashi Shimizu | 继承《咒怨》的恐怖风格。 |
| 9 | **《恐怖遊戲》** (The Babadook) | 2014 | Jennifer Kent | 以母亲与孩子的关系为核心的心理恐怖。 |
|10 | **《血腥小屋》** (The Cabin in the Woods) | 2012 | Drew Goddard | 对恐怖套路进行讽刺与颠覆。 |

Feel free to let me know if you’d like recommendations in a specific sub‑genre (e.g., supernatural, psychological, slasher) or from a particular country!
